“`

“In this aspect, it mainly depends on one’s own enlightenment…”

The robust man thought for a moment, just about to speak.

Just then.

Other evolvers in the Central Plaza Area started to boil with excitement and noise.

“What’s going on?”

...

The robust man quickly learned from the evolvers nearby that the mysterious founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had actually uploaded a training lecture video on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“A lecture video?”

The robust man’s spirit was lifted.

Given the popularity of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, naturally, there were many videos related to this evolutionary path.

This included personal experience videos from many evolvers who had cultivated to the Second Rank and Third Rank of Martial Dao.

However.

Many of these Second Rank and Third Rank Martial Dao evolvers’ training experience videos were inaccurate or even wrong.

“Quick, get into the account of the founder of Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

The robust man immediately ordered several youths beside him. They were all evolvers practicing the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, just one step away from advancing.

“Okay.”

The youths were also full of excitement, as the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was universally recognized as a great evolutionary scholar.

Watching a training analysis video uploaded by such a person would be beneficial even for those not practicing Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

What about them?

“I’ll take a look too.”

The robust man also opened the video and watched attentively.

A moment later.

The virtual world boiled again.

“So that’s how it is, to step into the Second Rank of Martial Dao, one needs not only to master a certain power, but also to achieve perfect control over oneself…”

“As expected of a great evolutionary scholar, each video is only twenty to thirty minutes long, but every sentence goes straight to the point, which is much better than those streamers talking about their understanding of Martial Dao.”

“How could those streamers compare with ‘Yuan’ the great scholar?”

Countless evolvers and high-ranked citizens kept exchanging insights, and the news about the lecture videos spread rapidly.

This caused more and more evolvers to join in and watch.

“I understand now.”

“No, why is there only half of the Third Rank chapter, where’s the rest?”

“So this is the essence of Martial Path Evolutionary Path? I’ve decided, I’ll let my son take the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.”

…..

The more one is an evolver of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, the more they realize how incredible the training analysis video uploaded by Lin Yuan is.

Questions and confusions that they could not comprehend no matter how hard they thought.

After watching the video, suddenly everything became clear as day.

It was like a lighthouse in the dark night, leading countless evolvers toward the most correct direction.

Some evolvers who had been on the wrong path immediately adjusted their training methods according to the training analysis video and eventually corrected their course.

Many people were excited, and even evolvers of other evolutionary paths gained a lot of insights.

Although the directions represented by different evolutionary paths are fundamentally different,

there are still some similarities in the core of cultivation; for those who have cultivated to the Fourth Rank and Fifth Rank in other evolutionary paths,

if they switch to cultivating another evolutionary path, their speed of cultivation will definitely be much faster.

“Donate, although Scholar Yuan doesn’t care about the money, I still want to donate.”

“Right, these videos have been of great help to me, I must donate.”

Individual accounts in the virtual world are allowed to receive ‘donations,’ and top star evolvers receive ‘donations’ that amount to billions every year.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Palace of the Thirteen Peaks.

“The eight hundred seventy-seventh space model…”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, occasionally raising his right hand, as strands of spatial power rippled like water in front of him.

“Finally completed…”

After a moment, a complete space model appeared in front of Lin Yuan.

With the demonstration of the Chikun Star Lord, Lin Yuan’s speed in comprehending subsequent space models had increased significantly. In just a day or two, he had comprehended another space model.

“It’s still too slow.”

“`

Lin Yuan frowned slightly.

“At this pace, it would take me more than half a year to fully comprehend the remaining hundred or so space models?”

For any evolver, the mere thought of comprehending more than a hundred space models in one to two years, especially the last hundred or so, was an unimaginable speed of enlightenment.

Even for the silver-haired woman Yin Ling, with her extremely high spatial talent, it would probably take thousands of years to comprehend more than a hundred space models.

But Lin Yuan had high demands for himself.

He wanted to open up the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Arts Evolution System as soon as possible.

“I can try the method my teacher mentioned…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The space in battlefields of different races was frequently fluctuating, and with an eternal spatial rift present, comprehending space rules there was akin to taking a shortcut.

“I can dispatch my Yang Spirit to the alien battlefield,”

Lin Yuan thought in his heart.

The battlefields of different races were filled with many opportunities, but understanding the space rules was only one aspect.

There were also tremendous dangers.

However,

the Yang Spirit, being Lin Yuan’s Primordial Spirit, wouldn’t undergo any loss if it were to perish outside; it could quickly be recondensed.

And the combat power of the Yang Spirit was just slightly weaker than Lin Yuan’s own, and if the Yang Spirit were to merge with the Yin God and become the Taiji Primordial Spirit, it would have a killing power not inferior to his own.

In the world of Immortal Tao, Lin Yuan’s own practice in the Cloud Mist Blessed Land was externalized through the Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit.

“First, let’s determine which alien battlefield to go to…”

A virtual screen appeared in front of Lin Yuan with lines of text flashing across it.

The Human Civilization Alliance waged wars in all directions, battling with numerous different species, and the total number of alien battlefields opened was two million six hundred thirty thousand four hundred sixty-two.

There were one hundred thirty-five large alien battlefields.

Eight hundred sixty-five thousand one hundred eleven medium-sized otherworldly battlefields.

The rest were small-sized otherworldly battlefields.

The scale of the large, medium, and small alien battlefields correlated with the top combat power on the battlefield, the number of strong beings, and the type of clans.

In small battlefields, the top combat power was generally at the Seventh Rank, with a few reaching the Eighth Layer.

In medium-sized battlefields, the top combat power was at the Eighth Layer, Ninth Rank, or even higher.

As for large battlefields… the one hundred thirty-five large alien battlefields currently opened by human civilization were all under the watchful eyes of supreme beings.

That is to say, in large battlefields, supreme beings could strike at any moment.

Species capable of contending with the Human Civilization Alliance on large battlefields were without exception peak clans like the Insect Race.

There lay the true meat grinder, where a war could lead to the fall of even Eighth Layer evolvers.

“For my first visit to an alien battlefield, it’s best to be cautious and choose a small-sized otherworldly battlefield…”

Lin Yuan didn’t set his sights on medium or large battlefields.

Although the death of the Yang Spirit wouldn’t incur any loss to Lin Yuan, merely requiring some time to reconvene,

it was still better not to die if possible.

Lin Yuan had a clear objective for heading to the alien battlefield.

He wasn’t like other evolvers who went to alien battlefields to kill different species, earn Merit Points, and so forth.

His sole purpose in going to the alien wars was for a better comprehension of the space rules.

With such a goal, a small-sized otherworldly battlefield was enough.

“Nearly two million small-sized otherworldly battlefields…”

Lin Yuan began to make his selection.

Even small-sized alien battlefields came in different types, and some had spatial fluctuations not much different from those in the Human Civilization Territory.

The small-sized otherworldly battlefield that Lin Yuan would choose certainly had to be one with noticeable spatial fluctuations.

Half an hour later.

Lin Yuan had roughly completed his review.

He finally settled on the small battlefield option.

“Battlefield C24763.”

Lin Yuan looked at the information displayed about this alien battlefield.

Battlefield C24763 was one opened by human civilization against the Heiyuan Clan.

The Heiyuan Clan hailed from the Cosmic Secret Realm called the Black Abyss, the native species of the secret realm.

Ever since the discovery of the Cosmic Secret Realm, Black Abyss, the Heiyuan Clan quickly integrated into the universe, joined the Insect Race Alliance, and collectively confronted the Human Civilization Alliance.

“The Heiyuan Clan, with their diverse forms, cultivate by swallowing the Heiyuan Force within the Cosmic Secret Realm Black Abyss, and they’re a powerful clan within the Insect Race Alliance…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.
